translationRepairs: On the guiwei day Yong, grand guardian and Prince of Gaoyang, was promoted to grand tutor and held additionally the post of grand minister; Yi, minister of works and Prince of Qinghe, was made minister over the masses; Huai, grand general of agile cavalry and Prince of Guanghe, was made minister of works.

On the guiwei day Yong, grand guardian and Prince of Gaoyang, was promoted to grand tutor and held additionally the post of grand minister; Yi, minister of works and Prince of Qinghe, was made minister over the masses; Huai, grand general of agile cavalry and Prince of Guangping, was made minister of works.
廣平王 is Prince of Guangping (cf. s0031); "Guanghe" is a mistranslation.
In the third month, on the jiachen day, the new moon, the empress dowager left the laity and became a nun, moving her residence to the Jintong quarter.
In the third month, on the jiachen day, the new moon, the empress dowager left the laity and became a nun, moving her residence to the Jinyong citadel.
金墉 is the Jinyong citadel of Luoyang; "Jintong" misreads the name.
In the sixth month the monk Fajing gathered a crowd and rebelled in Jizhou, killed the magistrate of Fucheng, and styled himself Mahayana.
In the sixth month the monk Faqing gathered a crowd and rebelled in Jizhou, killed the magistrate of Fucheng, and styled himself Mahayana.
法慶 is romanized Faqing; "Fajing" is a misreading of 慶.
On the dingwei day an edict made Yuan Yao, acting right honorable grand master, general who campaigns north to attack Fajing.
On the dingwei day an edict made Yuan Yao, acting right honorable grand master, general who campaigns north to attack Faqing.
法慶 is romanized Faqing (consistent with the source).
On the jiayin day Yuan Yao, who campaigns north, defeated and beheaded Fajing and more than a hundred chieftains; their heads were sent to the capital.
On the jiayin day Yuan Yao, who campaigns north, defeated and beheaded Faqing and more than a hundred chieftains; their heads were sent to the capital.
法慶 is romanized Faqing (consistent with the source).
On the gengchen day Tian Chaoqiu, Xiao Yan's inspector of Dingzhou, led three thousand men to request surrender.
On the gengchen day Tian Chaoxiu, Xiao Yan's inspector of Dingzhou, led three thousand men to request surrender.
田超秀: 秀 is xiu; "Chaoqiu" is a misromanization.

On the wushen day Hu Guozhen, director of the secretariat and commissioner with the golden axe, was made minister of works; Yue, special advanced and Prince of Runan, was made director of the secretariat and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

On the wushen day Hu Guozhen, director of the secretariat and commissioner with the golden axe, was made minister over the masses; Yue, special advanced and Prince of Runan, was made director of the secretariat and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.
司徒公 is minister over the masses, not minister of works (司空).

In the eighth month, on the yisi day, Hu Guozhen, attendant at the secretariat, director of the secretariat, equal in rank with the three excellencies, and Duke of Anding commandery, was made area commander of Yong, Jing, Qi, Hua, East Qin, and Bin—six provinces—grand general of agile cavalry, commissioner with the golden axe, and inspector of Yongzhou.

In the eighth month, on the yisi day, Hu Guozhen, attendant at the secretariat, director of the secretariat, equal in rank with the three excellencies, and Duke of Anding commandery, was made area commander of Yong, Jing, Qi, Hua, East Qin, and Bin—six provinces—grand general of agile cavalry, commander-unequaled with equal precedence to the three excellencies, and inspector of Yongzhou.
開府儀同三司 means opening a headquarters with precedence equal to the three excellencies; "golden axe" is wrong.
In the fourth month of summer, on the dingyou day, Hu Guozhen, minister of works, died.
In the fourth month of summer, on the dingyou day, Hu Guozhen, minister over the masses, died.
司徒 is minister over the masses, not minister of works.
羌 is Qiang, not Di (氐).
In the eleventh month, on the jiazi day, Mou Hanlong, Xiao Yan's general who pacifies the west and inspector of Bazhou, sent envoys to request surrender.
In the eleventh month, on the jiazi day, Mou Hanchong, Xiao Yan's general who pacifies the west and inspector of Bazhou, sent envoys to request surrender.
寵 is romanized chong; "Hanlong" misreads the name.

In the first month of spring in the first year of Zhenguang, on the yiyou day, an edict said, "Founding the state and binding the people—establishing teaching is the root; honoring teachers and exalting the Way is the canon from of old.

In the first month of spring in the first year of Zhengguang, on the yiyou day, an edict said, "Founding the state and binding the people—establishing teaching is the root; honoring teachers and exalting the Way is the canon from of old.

In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingzi day, Yuan Cha, attendant at the secretariat, and Liu Teng, palace attendant, escorted the emperor to the front hall, [4] and forged an edict of Empress Dowager Hu saying, "Wei has possessed the realm; generation after generation its light has been renewed.

In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingzi day, Yuan Cha, attendant at the palace, and Liu Teng, palace attendant, escorted the emperor to the front hall, [4] and forged an edict of Empress Dowager Hu saying, "Wei has possessed the realm; generation after generation its light has been renewed.
侍中 is attendant at the palace.
On the wushen day, Huangfu Ji, Grand General of the Guard and Bearer of the Triple Staff, died.
On the wushen day, Huangfu Ji, Grand General of the Guard and equal in rank with the three excellencies, died.
儀同三司 means equal in rank with the three excellencies.
On the guichou day, Hou Gang, Palace Attendant and Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, was additionally made Bearer of the Triple Staff.
On the guichou day, Hou Gang, Palace Attendant and Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, was additionally made equal in rank with the three excellencies.
儀同三司 means equal in rank with the three excellencies.
Therefore the Northern Ping reform was fixed in Han times and Yang Wei drafted calculations in Wei days.
Therefore the Marquis of Beiping fixed the reform in Han times and Yang Wei drafted calculations in Wei days.
北平 is Zhang Cang, Marquis of Beiping, not a "Northern Ping reform".
Let it now be proclaimed inner and outer and styled the Zhenguang calendar.
Let it now be proclaimed inner and outer and styled the Zhengguang calendar.

On jiashen day an edict ordered Li Chong, grand general who conquers on horseback and minister of the Masters of Writing, and Yuan Zuan, general of the center army and acting right vice director of the Masters of Writing, to lead one hundred thousand cavalry against the Rouran; they went beyond the frontier more than three thousand li, failed to overtake them, and returned.

On jiashen day an edict ordered Li Chong, grand general of agile cavalry and director of the Masters of Writing, and Yuan Zuan, general of the center army and acting right vice director of the Masters of Writing, to lead one hundred thousand cavalry against the Rouran; they went beyond the frontier more than three thousand li, failed to overtake them, and returned.
驃騎大將軍 is grand general of agile cavalry; 尚書令 is director.
Hence Fang Shu held office as an elder statesman, and Zhao Chongnian because of his own vigor was retained.
Hence Fang Shu held office as an elder statesman, and Zhao Chongguo because of his own vigor was retained.
An edict made Yu, prince of Huaiyang, general who guards the army and acting general who campaigns north, grand commander of all armies of the northern campaign, to attack them.
An edict made Yu, prince of Linhuai, general who guards the army and acting general who campaigns north, grand commander of all armies of the northern campaign, to attack them.
臨淮 is Linhuai, not Huaiyang (淮陽).
In the fifth month Yu, prince of Huaiyang, was defeated at Wuyuan and stripped of office and rank.
In the fifth month Yu, prince of Linhuai, was defeated at Wuyuan and stripped of office and rank.
臨淮 is Linhuai, not Huaiyang (淮陽).
On wuwu day Chen, prince of Hejian, and Yu, prince of Huaiyang, had their original fiefs restored.
On wuwu day Chen, prince of Hejian, and Yu, prince of Linhuai, had their original fiefs restored.
臨淮 is Linhuai, not Huaiyang (淮陽).
Separate commander Lu Zuyuan defeated them; Chen fled north.
Separate commander Lu Zuqian defeated them; Chen fled north.
On renshen day an edict made Li Chong, minister of the Masters of Writing, grand commander and ordered him to lead Yuan, prince of Guangyang, and others on the northern campaign.
On renshen day an edict made Li Chong, director of the Masters of Writing, grand commander and ordered him to lead Yuan, prince of Guangyang, and others on the northern campaign.
In the sixth month the people of Qin Province, Moqi Taiqi, seized the city and rebelled, styled himself King of Qin, and killed Inspector Li Yan.
In the sixth month the people of Qin Province, Mozhe Taiti, seized the city and rebelled, styled himself King of Qin, and killed Inspector Li Yan.
莫折太提 is Mozhe Taiti.
On wuxu day Moqi Niansheng sent Commander Dou Shuang to attack Pantou commandery.
On wuxu day Mozhe Niansheng sent Commander Dou Shuang to attack Pantou commandery.
In the third month the people of Woye Garrison, Po Luhan Baling, gathered a crowd and rebelled, [8] killed the garrison commander, and styled their era True King, year one.
In the third month the people of Woye Garrison, Poluohan Baling, gathered a crowd and rebelled, [8] killed the garrison commander, and styled their era True King, year one.
破落汗 is a single surname, Poluohan.
On dingyou day the herdsman Yu Qizhen of South Xiurong rebelled and killed Lu Yan, grand master of splendid carriages.
On dingyou day the herdsman Yu Qizhen of South Xiurong rebelled and killed Lu Yan, chamberlain for the imperial stud.
太僕卿 is chamberlain for the imperial stud.
In the tenth month of winter the people of Ying Province, Liu Anding and Jiudexing, seized the city and rebelled and seized Li Zhongzun, inspector.
In the tenth month of winter the people of Ying Province, Liu Anding and Jiu Dexing, seized the city and rebelled and seized Li Zhongzun, inspector.
就德興 is surname Jiu, given name Dexing.
In the eleventh month, on wushen day, Moqi Tiansheng took Qi Province, seized Yuan Zhi, commander, and Pei Fenzhi, inspector.
In the eleventh month, on wushen day, Mozhe Tiansheng took Qi Province, seized Yuan Zhi, commander, and Pei Fenzhi, inspector.
That month Moqi Niansheng sent troops to attack Liang Province; the townsman Zhao Tianan again seized the inspector and joined them.
That month Mozhe Niansheng sent troops to attack Liang Province; the townsman Zhao Tianan again seized the inspector and joined them.

On renchen day Moqi Niansheng sent commanders Yang Zha, Liang Xiabian, Jiang Qi, and others to attack Qiuchi commandery; Wei Zijian, mobile office director and inspector of East Yi Province, sent General Sheng Qian to defeat them and beheaded Xiabian, Qi, and others.

On renchen day Mozhe Niansheng sent commanders Yang Zha, Liang Xiabian, Jiang Qi, and others to attack Qiuchi commandery; Wei Zijian, mobile office director and inspector of East Yi Province, sent General Sheng Qian to defeat them and beheaded Xiabian, Qi, and others.

Wei Zijian, eastern route mobile office director and inspector of East Yi Province, won over the Di people of South Qin, restored six commanderies and twelve garrisons, and also beheaded the bandit king Han Zuxiang.

Wei Zijian, Shannan mobile office director and inspector of East Yi Province, won over the Di people of South Qin, restored six commanderies and twelve garrisons, and also beheaded the bandit king Han Zuxiang.
山南行臺 is the Shannan mobile office.

An edict appointed Yu, general who guards the army and Prince of Linhuai, together with Li Xian, Master of Writing, as commanders; Yanming, general of the guard, libationer of the Directorate of Education, and Prince of Anfeng, as eastern-route mobile administrator; and restored Li Chong, Bearer of the Triple Staff, to his offices and rank, making him grand commander of the eastern route. Together they were to attack Xu Province.

An edict appointed Yu, general who guards the army and Prince of Linhuai, together with Li Xian, Master of Writing, as commanders; Yanming, general of the guard, libationer of the Directorate of Education, and Prince of Anfeng, as eastern-route mobile administrator; and restored Li Chong, equal in rank with the three excellencies, to his offices and rank, making him grand commander of the eastern route. Together they were to attack Xu Province.
In the second month Yuan Cha, leader of the court guards, was made grand general who conquers on horseback and bearer of the triple staff.
In the second month Yuan Cha, leader of the court guards, was made grand general of agile cavalry and equal in rank with the three excellencies.
驃騎大將軍、儀同三司 mistranslated.
Mu Shao, palace attendant, special advance, and grand general of the guard, was made bearer of the triple staff.
Mu Shao, palace attendant, special advance, and grand general of the guard, was made equal in rank with the three excellencies.
The provinces and commanderies that formerly memorialized the Minister of Works should all now memorialize the chancellor's office for implementation; warrants and notices are likewise."
The provinces and commanderies that formerly memorialized the Minister over the Masses should all now memorialize the chancellor's office for implementation; warrants and notices are likewise."
司徒 is minister over the masses.
That month the separate commander of Po Luhan Baling, Wang Ye Bulu, and others took Huai Shuo Garrison.
That month the separate commander of Poluohan Baling, Wang Ye Bulu, and others took Huai Shuo Garrison.
破落汗 is a single surname.
In the fourth month of summer Xiao Yan's inspector of Yi Province Xiao Yuanyou sent generals Fan Wenchao and Xiao Shicheng and others to besiege Little Sword Garrison.
In the fourth month of summer Xiao Yan's inspector of Yi Province Xiao Yuanyou sent generals Fan Wenchi and Xiao Shicheng and others to besiege Little Sword Garrison.
The character 熾 is read chi.
Bing Chou, inspector of Yi Province, sent his son Zida; Wei Zijian, mobile office director, sent separate commander Chunyu Dan to resist and attack them.
Bing Qiu, inspector of Yi Province, sent his son Zida; Wei Zijian, mobile office director, sent separate commander Chunyu Dan to resist and attack them.

At the end of the Divine Tortoise era powerful ministers usurped command; Yuan Cha and Liu Teng secretly influenced each other, so that the empress dowager was shut away in the rear palace, the grand tutor and prince of Qinghe were killed without crime, Xi, inspector of Xiang Province and prince of Zhongshan, was wantonly destroyed, and Xi Kangsheng, right guard general, was likewise executed.

At the end of the Shengui era powerful ministers usurped command; Yuan Cha and Liu Teng secretly influenced each other, so that the empress dowager was shut away in the rear palace, the grand tutor and prince of Qinghe were killed without crime, Xi, inspector of Xiang Province and prince of Zhongshan, was wantonly destroyed, and Xi Kangsheng, right guard general, was likewise executed.
神龜 is the reign period Shengui.
On wuzi day, [12] Li Chong, grand general who conquers on horseback and bearer of the triple staff, died.
On wuzi day, [12] Li Chong, grand general of agile cavalry and equal in rank with the three excellencies, died.
驃騎大將軍、儀同三司 mistranslated.
On wuzi day Moqi Niansheng sent commanders Du Hei'er and Du Guang and others to attack Qiuchi commandery.
On wuzi day Mozhe Niansheng sent commanders Du Hei'er and Du Guang and others to attack Qiuchi commandery.
In the eleventh month, on xinhai day, an edict stated: "Great filial piety honors kin; this is set out in ancient canons. Hence the peace of Ping in old age filled the court with sons.
In the eleventh month, on xinhai day, an edict stated: "Great filial piety honors kin; this is set out in ancient canons. Hence Anping in his old age filled the court with sons.
安平 alludes to the Prince of Anping, not the phrase peace.
That month Yu, prince of Huaiyang, was made general who campaigns south and led troops to attack the Man of Luyang.
That month Yu, prince of Linhuai, was made general who campaigns south and led troops to attack the Man of Luyang.
In the third month, on gengzi day, Yanming, prince of Anfeng, grand general who conquers on horseback and inspector of Xuzhou, was made bearer of the triple staff.
In the third month, on gengzi day, Yanming, prince of Anfeng, grand general of agile cavalry and inspector of Xuzhou, was made equal in rank with the three excellencies.
驃騎大將軍 and 儀同三司 mistranslated.
On jiayin day the western Tiele Huluoyang rebelled at Sanggan and linked with the herdsmen of Hexi to the west.
On jiayin day the western Tiele Hulü Luoyang rebelled at Sanggan and linked with the herdsmen of Hexi to the west.
斛律洛陽 is surname Hulü, given name Luoyang.
On guisi day Hui, palace attendant, general of chariots and cavalry, and prince of Chengyang, was made bearer of the triple staff.
On guisi day Hui, palace attendant, general of chariots and cavalry, and prince of Chengyang, was made equal in rank with the three excellencies.
The people of Shuozhou, Xianyu Ahu and Kudifengle, seized the city and rebelled.
The people of Shuozhou, Xianyu Ahu and Kudi Fengle, seized the city and rebelled.
厙狄豐樂 is surname Kudi, given name Fengle.
On wushen day Baoyin, prince of Qi, grand general who conquers on horseback and opener of the office, was made bearer of the triple staff.
On wushen day Baoyin, prince of Qi, grand general of agile cavalry and with his own office establishment, was made equal in rank with the three excellencies.
驃騎大將軍, 開府 and 儀同三司 mistranslated.

Yuan, minister of personnel and prince of Guangyang, was made grand general who conquers on horseback and bearer of the triple staff, and soon grand commander, leading Rong, commander and prince of Zhangwu, on the northern campaign against Xiuli.

Yuan, minister of personnel and prince of Guangyang, was made grand general of agile cavalry and equal in rank with the three excellencies, and soon grand commander, leading Rong, commander and prince of Zhangwu, on the northern campaign against Xiuli.
驃騎大將軍 and 儀同三司 mistranslated.
On yichou day Zhen Sun, general who pacifies the west and household minister, was made commander to attack the rebel Hu of Fen Province.
On yichou day Zhensun, general who pacifies the west, grand master of splendid happiness and director of the imperial clan, was made commander to attack the rebel Hu of Fen Province.
宗正珍孫 is Zhensun, director of the imperial clan; 光祿大夫 rendering fixed.
Hengzhi, grand general of the guard and western route commander, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of the triple staff.
Hengzhi, grand general of the guard and western route commander, was made general of chariots and cavalry and equal in rank with the three excellencies.
On yimao day Lue, prince of Dongping, was made left grand master of splendid carriages and bearer of the triple staff.
On yimao day Lue, prince of Dongping, was made left grand master of splendid happiness and equal in rank with the three excellencies.
左光祿大夫 and 儀同三司 mistranslated.
[15] Yu, prince of Huaiyang, grand general who conquers on horseback and eastern route mobile office commander, was made bearer of the triple staff.
[15] Yu, prince of Linhuai, grand general of agile cavalry and eastern route mobile office commander, was made equal in rank with the three excellencies.
臨淮 is Linhuai; 驃騎大將軍 and 儀同三司 mistranslated.
Commander Yi Longsheng attacked Ba, was defeated, and died in battle.
Commander Yi Pensheng attacked Ba, was defeated, and died in battle.

On jiashen day Chang Jing again defeated Luozhou, beheaded his Prince of Wuchuan Hebawenxing and separate commander Houmochen Sheng, and captured alive four hundred men and women and more than five thousand oxen and donkeys.

On jiashen day Chang Jing again defeated Luozhou, beheaded his Prince of Wuchuan Heba Wenxing and separate commander Houmochen Sheng, and captured alive four hundred men and women and more than five thousand oxen and donkeys.
賀拔文興 is surname Heba, given name Wenxing.
Jiudexing took Ping Province and killed Inspector Wang Mainu.
Jiu Dexing took Ping Province and killed Inspector Wang Mainu.
就德興 is surname Jiu, given name Dexing.
That month Moqi Tiansheng offered surrender; Baoyin sent Cui Shihe, left assistant of the mobile office, to enter and hold Qin Province.
That month Mozhe Tiansheng offered surrender; Baoyin sent Cui Shihe, left assistant of the mobile office, to enter and hold Qin Province.

In the third year, spring, first month, on jiaxu day, Huangfu Du, duke of minister of works, was made minister over the masses; Baoyin, bearer of the triple staff, was made minister of works; Hao, general of chariots and cavalry and prince of Beihai, was made grand general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of the triple staff.

In the third year, spring, first month, on jiaxu day, Huangfu Du, minister of works, was made minister over the masses; Baoyin, equal in rank with the three excellencies, was made minister of works; Hao, general of chariots and cavalry and prince of Beihai, was made grand general of chariots and cavalry and equal in rank with the three excellencies.
司空公 and 儀同三司 mistranslated.
Zuhui, inspector, and Shen, mobile office director, both fled; Zuhui died in the battle line.
Bi Zuhui, inspector of Bin Province, and Yang Shen, mobile office director, both fled; Zuhui died in the battle line.
On wuzi day Huangfu Du, minister of works, was made grand commandant.
On wuzi day Huangfu Du, minister over the masses, was made grand commandant.
司徒 is minister over the masses.
That month Cheng Jingjun, Xiao Yan's general, raided Pengcheng; an edict made Cui Xiaofen, yuanwai changshi, mobile office commander to lead generals and drive them off.
That month Cheng Jingjun, Xiao Yan's general, raided Pengcheng; an edict made Cui Xiaofen, supernumerary attendant-in-ordinary, mobile office commander to lead generals and drive them off.

On wuchen day an edict ordered the return of the carriage for a northern campaign; an edict made Yuan Ziyou, grand master of splendid carriages with golden seal and purple cord, grand commander to attack Ge Rong.

On wuchen day an edict ordered the return of the carriage for a northern campaign; an edict made Yuan Ziyong, grand master of splendid happiness with golden seal and purple cord, grand commander to attack Ge Rong.
源子邕 is Yuan Ziyong; 光祿 rendering fixed.
In the seventh month of autumn the people of Chen commandery, Liu Huo and Zheng Bian, rebelled at Xihua, styled their era Tian shou; provincial troops suppressed and pacified them.
In the seventh month of autumn the people of Chen commandery, Liu Huo and Zheng Bian, rebelled at Xihua, styled their era Tianshou; provincial troops suppressed and pacified them.
天授 is a single era name.

That month Liu Shao, inspector of Qing Province and prince of Pengcheng, and Hu Ping, inspector of South Qing, sent generals to behead the head of Peng Qun, Xiao Yan's general, and capture more than two thousand.

That month Yuan Shao, inspector of Qing Province and prince of Pengcheng, and Hu Ping, inspector of South Qing, sent generals to behead Peng Qun, Xiao Yan's general, and capture more than two thousand.
彭城王劭 is the imperial clansman Yuan Shao.
In the eighth month commanders Yuan Ziyou, Li Gui, and Pei Yan attacked Ye.
In the eighth month commanders Yuan Ziyong, Li Gui, and Pei Yan attacked Ye.
In the ninth month, on xinmao day, [21] Yuan Qinghe, inspector of East Yi Province, rebelled with the south of the city.
In the ninth month, on xinmao day, [21] Yuan Qinghe, inspector of East Yi Province, defected to the south with his city.
以城南叛 means went over to the south with the city.
The townspeople of Qin Province killed Moqi Niansheng and acted as provincial governor themselves.
Du Can, a townsman of Qin Province, killed Mozhe Niansheng and acted as provincial governor himself.
Name 杜粲 omitted; 莫折 is Mozhe.
On xinhai day Rong, general of the guard and grand commander who campaigns against barbarians, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of the triple staff.
On xinhai day Rong, general of the guard and grand commander who campaigns against barbarians, was made general of chariots and cavalry and equal in rank with the three excellencies.
In the twelfth month, on wushen day, commanders Yuan Ziyou and Pei Yan fought Ge Rong, were defeated at the bend of the Zhang River northeast of Yangping, and both died in battle.
In the twelfth month, on wushen day, commanders Yuan Ziyong and Pei Yan fought Ge Rong, were defeated at the bend of the Zhang River northeast of Yangping, and both died in battle.

In the first year of Wutai, spring, first month, on guihai day, Hao, prince of Beihai, was made grand general who conquers on horseback, opener of the office, bearer of the triple staff, and inspector of Xiang Province.

In the first year of Wutai, spring, first month, on guihai day, Hao, prince of Beihai, was made grand general of agile cavalry, with his own office establishment and equal in rank with the three excellencies, and inspector of Xiang Province.
驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司 mistranslated.

On dingchou day the townspeople of Yong Province, Hou Zhongde and others together attacked Baoyin; Baoyin took the Princess of Nanyang and her son and with a little more than a hundred horsemen crossed the Wei and fled; Yong Province was pacified.

On dingchou day the townspeople of Yong Province, Hou Zhongde and others together attacked Baoyin; Baoyin took the Princess of Nanyang and his sons and with a little more than a hundred horsemen crossed the Wei and fled; Yong Province was pacified.

In the second month Changsun Zhi was made general of chariots and cavalry, opener of the office, bearer of the triple staff, inspector of Yong Province, and also right vice director of the Masters of Writing and western route mobile office commander.

In the second month Changsun Zhi was made grand general of chariots and cavalry, with his own office establishment and equal in rank with the three excellencies, inspector of Yong Province, and concurrently vice director of the Department of State Affairs and western route mobile office commander.
車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、兼尚書僕射 mistranslated.
Erzhu Rong, equal in rank to the Three Departments and grand commander, submitted a memorial asking leave to march to the capital; he mustered his army and turned south.
Erzhu Rong, equal in rank with the three excellencies and grand commander, submitted a memorial asking leave to march to the capital; he mustered his army and turned south.
In the third month, on the guimao day, Ge Rong took Cangzhou and seized Inspector Xue Qingzhi; eight or nine residents in ten perished.
In the third month, on the guiwei day, Ge Rong took Cangzhou and seized Inspector Xue Qingzhi; eight or nine residents in ten perished.
In summer, the fourth month, on the xuxu day, Erzhu Rong crossed the Yellow River.
In summer, the fourth month, on the wuxu day, Erzhu Rong crossed the Yellow River.

Liang's Heng province lay at Hanhuang, in present-day Yingde of Guangdong, far from Yizhou; this annal, juan 70 Biography of Fu Jianyan, and juan 98 Biography of Xiao Yan all call him "inspector of Heng province"—suspected errors throughout.

Liang's Heng province lay at Hanhuang, in present-day Yingde of Guangdong, far from Yizhou; this annal, juan 70 Biography of Fu Shuyan, and juan 98 Biography of Xiao Yan all call him "inspector of Heng province"—suspected errors throughout.
The state of Mohe presented hardwood arrows: in all editions "Mohe" is corrupted to "Nianlu"; according to Cefu juan 969
The state of Wuji presented hardwood arrows: in all editions "Wuji" is corrupted to "Nianlu"; according to Cefu juan 969
Poluohan Baling rebelled; an edict ordered Prince of Huaiyang Yuan Yu to campaign against him.
Poluohan Baling rebelled; an edict ordered Yuan Yu, Prince of Linhuai to campaign against him.
Tai Commander Bu Chao of the garrison people seized Gaoping: Zizhi tongjian juan 154
Taiti sent the townsman Bu Chao to seize Gaoping: Zizhi tongjian juan 154
太提 is the rebel Taiti; 城人 is townsman.
Tuyuhun lord Foulian sent troops to campaign against Liang province: Beishi juan 4 has the character "sent" before "troops."
Tuyuhun lord Fulianchou sent troops to campaign against Liang province: Beishi juan 4 has the character "sent" before "troops."
Advanced in enfeoffment Guangchuan county founding marquis Yuan Zhao to Prince of Changshan: in all editions "Zhao" is written "Shao."
Advanced in enfeoffment Guangchuan county founding duke Yuan Zhao to Prince of Changshan: in all editions "Zhao" is written "Shao."
Examining Differences says the Wei annals and Biography of Cao Shibiao read "Zhan Seng"; it prefers the Biography of Xiahou Dai in Liang.
Examining Differences says the Wei annals and Biography of Cao Shibiao read "Zhan Seng"; it prefers the Biography of Xiahou Kui in Liang.
